caption: A hairdryer is aimed at crayons taped to the top of a canvas, and the crayons melt and run down the canvas in coloured streaks that harden lower down.

sa.check: Crayons are taped to the top of a canvas.
A hairdryer is aimed at the crayons.
Coloured wax runs down the canvas.
The streaks harden lower down the canvas.
The order is heat, melt, run down, harden.

pc.expect: The melted wax runs downward from each crayon's tip, straight down the canvas.
pc.fail: A streak runs upward from a crayon; or travels sideways across the canvas and stays level; or a drop of wax leaves the canvas and floats; or wax gathers above the crayons.

pc.expect: Each streak only grows downward while heat is on it, and where it has stopped and set it stays set.
pc.fail: A streak retreats back up toward its crayon; or a set streak low on the canvas runs again with no fresh wax reaching it; or a streak's colour drains away leaving the canvas bare; or the crayons grow back as the streaks lengthen.

pc.expect: The wax is a thin liquid where the dryer plays on it and a raised dull ridge where it has cooled; the crayon bodies soften and slump at the tip.
pc.fail: A streak stays glossy and runny far from the dryer while wax nearer the heat has already set dull; or a streak sets as a spike standing out from the canvas; or the canvas sags or melts with the wax; or the crayons shatter dry.

pc.expect: The melting follows the dryer: crayons in its stream melt and run while ones away from it stay solid.
pc.fail: Crayons the dryer is not aimed at run while the ones in its stream stay solid; or every crayon runs at once while the dryer is plainly aimed at one; or a streak appears below a crayon that is still whole and dry.
pc.precondition: The hairdryer's nozzle and the direction it points are in view.

pc.expect: The canvas and the crayons stay put; the crayons change only by softening at the tip.
pc.fail: A crayon slides across the canvas with nothing pushing it; or the canvas swings or tips with nothing touching it; or a crayon leaves the canvas while its tape still holds it.

pc.expect: The crayons stay taped where they are and the wax on the canvas came down from them.
pc.fail: A streak appears with no crayon above it; or a crayon vanishes while still whole; or a new crayon appears on the canvas; or wax passes through the canvas and shows on its back.

pc.expect: Each streak keeps its crayon's colour, and the bare canvas and the wall behind stay the same.
pc.fail: A streak is a colour no crayon has; or the bare canvas changes shade; or the wall behind changes.
